description: In repos/goal-host-vessel/src/independent-recompute.ts, extend the exported reconcileDerivations function to accept an optional third parameter `recipeRescue?: { agreed: number; disagreed: number }`. Keep the existing behavior identical when recipeRescue is undefined. When a is non-null but b is null (the "only one derivation" branch), AND recipeRescue is provided AND a > 0 AND recipeRescue.agreed >= 10 AND recipeRescue.agreed > recipeRescue.disagreed * 4, return { truth: a } instead of the null/abstain result — this lets a strongly-proven recipe answer (side a) rescue the measurement when its fresh partner (side b) merely FAILED to produce. Do NOT rescue when b is non-null (a real disagreement still abstains) and do NOT rescue a degenerate truth (a <= 0). Keep the signature backward compatible so existing two-argument callers are unchanged.
